title: Copula Active Subspaces II: Error Decomposition, A Posteriori Estimation, and Sharpness of the Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2610.14498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Copula Active Subspaces (CAS) method of Part I estimates a non-Gaussian observation-noise density $\pi_{\boldsymbol{n}}$ from residual samples. Its KL divergence $\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_{\boldsymbol{n}}\,\|\,\widehat\pi_{\boldsymbol{n}})$ admits an exact decomposition into marginal, projection and reduced-density terms and bounds the posterior KL divergence averaged over the true predictive distribution. We derive a priori bounds for these terms, together with estimates or bounds from residual samples. Weighted nearest-neighbour entropy estimates are used for the marginal and reduced-density terms, with asymptotic standard errors in exact rank coordinates. For the projection error, the score is fitted on one subsample, and its mean squared magnitude outside the retained subspace is estimated on the other. Corrections for score and rank-transform errors then give a theoretical upper bound with probability at least $1-\delta$.

translated_title: Copula主动子空间 II：误差分解、后验估计与界的锐利性
translated_abstract: 第一部分提出的Copula主动子空间（CAS）方法从残差样本中估计非高斯观测噪声密度 $\pi_{\boldsymbol{n}}$。其KL散度 $\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_{\boldsymbol{n}}\,\|\,\widehat\pi_{\boldsymbol{n}})$ 可被精确分解为边缘项、投影项和降密度项，并对在真实预测分布上取平均的后验KL散度构成上界。我们推导了这些项的先验界，同时给出了基于残差样本的估计或界。边缘项和降密度项采用加权最近邻熵估计，并在精确秩坐标下给出渐近标准误差。对于投影误差，在一个子样本上拟合得分函数，在另一个子样本上估计其在保留子空间之外的平均平方幅值。随后通过对得分误差和秩变换误差进行修正，得到一个以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率成立的理论上界。
tldr: 本文为Copula主动子空间方法建立了KL散度的精确误差分解，推导了边缘、投影和降密度各项的先验界及基于残差样本的后验估计，最终获得以至少1-δ概率成立的理论上界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an exact KL-divergence error decomposition for the Copula Active Subspaces method, deriving a priori bounds and residual-sample-based estimates for the marginal, projection, and reduced-density terms to obtain a theoretical upper bound holding with probability at least 1-δ.
